scope: Supplemental bounded public-source search after the commercial code/policy freeze. This record changes no simulation parameters or qualification gates.
method: Public primary marketplace listings and vendor service/product pages, located through search and opened without accounts, messages, spending or paid calls. Search sought narrow EPANET/sensor-planning quotes, awarded jobs and measured human task times; broad utility masterplans were not used as per-package times.

observations.facts: Existing small water network optimization project, marked Completed and Awarded. Posted about four years ago. Visible awarded bid INR5000 with two-day delivery; five proposals. Posted buyer budget INR600-1500 differed from awarded bid.
observations.inference: Evidence of a narrower historical buyer-supplier match and a low-price competing offer, stronger than an authored demand assumption.
observations.limits: No payment receipt, elapsed work hours, acceptance artifact, current volume or verified equivalence to the robust observation-plan package. Two days is a delivery promise, not sixteen labor hours. Historical award cannot establish present AGI ALPHA willingness to pay or CAD250 participation. Currency is retained as displayed; no FX conversion is asserted.

observations.facts: Closed buyer request for EPANET water-network scenarios using incomplete data/models, including pressure and water quality. Posted about twelve months ago. Budget INR600-1500; four proposals; displayed average bid INR2563.
observations.limits: No award or successful paid delivery visible. Buyer budget and bids are not realized transactions, qualified service costs, or current demand volume.

observations.facts: EPANET subconsultant sought by a water/sewer engineering company for a 195-hectare residential network, pump/storage, DWG and PDF plans and model input/output tables. Twenty-two proposals; displayed average bid USD397.
observations.limits: Substantially broader scope than our model-based observation plan. No awarded price or measured effort established. Average bids are not realized revenues, quality-matched quotes or package demand.

observations.facts: BGEO offers Giswater consulting for data migration, project setup and first EPANET/SWMM simulation using the customer's data, in 2-hour, 5-hour and 10-hour assistance packs.
observations.limits: No published pack price or observed task-completion time. Purchased assistance hours do not establish required labor for our deliverable or buyer uptake.

observations.facts: Qatium Pressure Sensor Placement version5.1 (updated October2025) requires a calibrated model. It uses EPANET hydraulic scenarios, pressure sensitivities and multi-objective placement for leak detection/isolation, including comparing additions of three or four sensors.
observations.limits: Vendor-described capability not reproduced here. Pressure-leak placement is adjacent to, not identical with, the water-quality source-observation plan. It must be considered before claiming investment advantage; competent humans may use such tools.

observations.facts: The rendered pricing page displays Q-one and Q-plus at GBP0/month with sales links, operational plugins and size/user limits, Enterprise custom pricing, and an Impact Program offering free or discounted technology access.
observations.limits: Eligibility, final quote and pressure-placement plugin entitlement were not verified. The visible page is not a binding zero-price quote or proof our complete service can be replaced without cost.

human_frontier_audit.cohort: All twenty admitted illustrative attempts, including unsold work; same modeled net revenue and card losses.
human_frontier_audit.production_component_interpretation: At the sourced CAD52/hour wage, labor alone above this time costs more than the authored CAD20.31949 AI variable cost per attempt. This does not establish full-cost advantage or observed task duration.
human_frontier_audit.sufficient_loss_formula: 60*(recognized net revenue - processing fees - dispute fees)/(20*CAD52).
human_frontier_audit.sufficient_loss_interpretation: If competent human labor alone exceeded this amount, the cohort would lose money even before other nonnegative human costs. Human fixed research, setup, nonlabor overhead and actual task time remain unknown; this is not the exact complete-cost human break-even or a demonstrated human loss.

conclusion: Closer external buyer activity and commercial alternatives were located, but matched labor time, present CAD250 willingness to pay, repeat volume and substitution remain unestablished. Keep the positive conditional scenarios and participation frontiers; do not release qualified earnings or claim a human-to-AI profitability crossing.
